# New renderings — iliad-078 (13.81–168)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἀναιδής (ἀναιδέος πέτρης, 13.139; of a rock, not a person) | "shameless" | "ruthless" | "pitiless", "unyielding", "bare"; follows the table’s λᾶας ἀναιδής (4.521, Odyssey 11.598) unchanged: `l` literal, `i` the sense |
| ὀλοοίτροχος (13.137; -τροχος from the root of τρέχω / τροχός; first half disputed) | "rolling boulder" | "rolling boulder" (+ note: first half of the word not known) | "ruinous roller" (commits to ὀλοός), "round stone", "crushing rock"; "boulder" because the word names a stone that runs down a slope |
| ποταμὸς χειμάρροος (13.138; χεῖμα + ῥέω) | "winter-flowing river" | "winter torrent" | "swollen river", "flood", "mountain stream"; χειμάρροος "flowing in winter" |
| ἔχματα (πέτρης, 13.139; ἔχω "hold") | "supports" | "supports" | "holds", "props", "foundations"; ἔχμα "what holds something fast" |
| στεφάνη (κατὰ στεφάνης, 13.138) | "brow" | "brow" | "crest", "summit", "rim"; στεφάνη "rim, crown" of a height |
| φυζακινός (φυζακινῇς ἐλάφοισιν, 13.102; from φύζα "flight, panic") | "flight-prone" | "timid" | "skittish", "fleet", "fugitive"; the word is rare and formed on φύζα, so `l` keeps the root |
| ἤϊα (θώων … ἤϊα πέλονται, 13.103) | "food" | "food" | "prey", "provisions", "meat" (each narrows the word); ἤϊα "provisions, food", the sense secure and the derivation not |
| θώς · πάρδαλις · λύκος (13.103) | "jackals" · "leopards" · "wolves" | "jackals" · "leopards" · "wolves" | "wild dogs", "panthers" (πάρδαλις is the spotted cat), "wolves" for λύκοι only; θώς is usually taken as the jackal (the note says "usually") |
| μεθημοσύνη (13.108, 13.121; from μεθίημι) | "slackness" | "slackness" | "negligence", "sloth", "cowardice"; follows the table's μεθίημι "slacken" |
| μεθίημι with πολέμοιο / θούριδος ἀλκῆς (13.97, 13.114, 13.116, 13.118) | "slacken from" | "slacken in" / "give up" (per sentence) | "relax", "give in to"; follows the table's row (4.234, 4.351) |
| ἀπητίμησε (13.113) | "dishonoured" | "dishonoured" | "slighted", "spurned", "cast off"; follows the table's ἀτιμάζω "dishonour" (1.11, 6.522) |
| λυγρὸς ἐών (of a man, 13.119) | "grievous" | "a sorry creature as he is" | "wretched" (reserved for δύστηνος), "miserable" (δειλός); `l` keeps the table's "grievous" (λυγρός, and the Odyssey's "grievous as you are" of a beggar); `i` gives the sense; departure from the Odyssey's `i`, because "grievous" of a man who slackens from war misleads in English |
| ὦ πέπονες (13.120) | "O good ones" | "My good fellows" (+ note: meaning not known; read as scornful) | "soft ones", "you sheep"; follows the table's ὦ πέπονες (2.235) |
| αἰδῶ καὶ νέμεσιν (13.122) | "shame and resentment" | "shame and resentment" (+ note: the resentment others feel at a shameful act) | "honour and indignation", "respect and blame"; αἰδώς "shame" (2.262), νέμεσις "resentment" (3.156) |
| νεῖκος (μέγα νεῖκος ὄρωρεν, 13.122) | "quarrel" | "quarrel" (+ note: here the fighting itself) | "strife" (kept for ἔρις), "battle", "conflict"; follows the table's reservation of "quarrel" for νεῖκος |
| κελευτιάω (κελευτιόων, 13.125; built on κελεύω) | "giving orders" | "calling out his orders" | "urging", "shouting commands"; "bid" is kept for κελεύω, and ὀτρύνω is "urge on" |
| ἀκέομαι (ἀκεώμεθα, ἀκεσταί, 13.115) | "heal" · "healable" | "mend" · "can be mended" | "cure" (kept for ἐξακέσαιο, 4.36), "make good", "repair"; ἀκέομαι "heal", the object (the harm done by slackness) unsaid |
| κρινθέντες (ἄριστοι κρινθέντες, 13.129; aorist passive of κρίνω) | "having been picked out" | "picked out for the place" | "chosen", "sorted", "drawn up"; κρίνω "separate, pick out" |
| ἔμιμνον (Τρῶάς τε καὶ Ἕκτορα, 13.129; μίμνω = μένω; also μίμνειν, 13.106) | "were awaiting" · "to await" | "stood up to" · "stand up to" | "withstood", "faced" (reserved for ἀντίος / ἐναντίον), "waited for" in `i`; μένω "wait for, stand up to" |
| προθέλυμνος (σάκεϊ προθελύμνῳ, 13.130; meaning not known) | "close-layered" | "layer on layer" (+ note: meaning not known; θέλυμνα "base, roots", "in layers" a guess) | "thick-set", "solid", "from the roots" (the table's προθέλυμνα, 9.541, said of trees); the note says the meaning is not known |
| φράσσω (φράξαντες δόρυ δουρί, 13.130) | "having fenced" | "locking" | "bracing", "pressing together"; φράσσω "fence, close up" |
| ἐπτύσσοντο (ἔγχεα … ἐπτύσσοντο, 13.134; πτύσσω "fold") | "were bending" | "bent" (+ note: sense a guess from the verb) | "were folding", "quivered", "wavered"; the note says it is a guess |
| ἱππόκομος (ἱππόκομοι κόρυθες, 13.132) | "horse-plumed" | "with horsehair plumes" | follows the table's ἱπποκόμος (12.339), unchanged |
| ἰθὺς φρονεῖν (ἰθὺς φρόνεον, 13.135) | "were minded straight on" | "their minds were set straight ahead" | "were of one mind", "were resolute"; ἰθύς "straight" (11.552, 12.453) |
| ἀντικρὺ μεμαώς (13.137) | "straight on, eager" | "eager, head-on" | follows the table's ἀντικρύ "head-on" (of fighting) and μεμαώς "eager" |
| κτυπέει (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ὕλη, 13.140; of a boulder) | "thunders" | "thunders" | "crashes" (turned down at 8.75), "resounds", "echoes"; follows the table's κτυπέω "thunder" |
| ἰσόπεδον (13.142) | "level ground" | "level ground" | "flat ground", "plain" (reserved for πεδίον); ἴσος + πέδον |
| ἀσφαλέως … ἔμπεδον (13.141) | "securely, steadily" | "surely and steadily" | "safely", "firmly"; ἔμπεδος "steady" (5.527) |
| ἐγχριμφθείς (13.146) | "pressed up close" | "pressed hard up against them" | "pushed back", "crowded"; aorist passive of ἐγχρίμπτω "press close against" |
| πυργηδόν (13.152) | "tower-fashion" | "like a tower" | "in towers", "in columns"; adverb in -δόν on πύργος |
| καὶ μάλα (καὶ μάλα πυργηδὸν … ἀρτύναντες, 13.152) | "even very much" | "however much" | "very well", "ever so"; makes the participle concessive |
| παραμένω (παρμένετ’, 13.151) | "stand by" | "stand by" | "stay with me" (adds an object), "hold fast"; imperative with no object stated |
| ὤριστος (θεῶν ὤριστος, 13.154; ὁ ἄριστος) | "the best of the gods" | "the best of the gods" | "the mightiest of the gods", "the noblest"; ἄριστος "best" (1.69, 2.82) |
| ἐρίγδουπος πόσις Ἥρης (Zeus unnamed, 13.154) | "the loud-crashing husband of Hera" | "the loud-crashing husband of Hera" | the table's row (7.411), unchanged; the name is not supplied, as with γαιήοχος / ἐνοσίχθων |
| γαιήοχος · ἐνοσίχθων (Poseidon unnamed, 13.83, 13.89, 13.125) | "the earth-holder" · "the earth-shaker" | "the earth-holder" · "the earth-shaker" | "Poseidon" (the Greek withholds the name); the table's rows (9.183, 11.241), unchanged |
| ὑπασπίδια προποδίζων (13.158) | "under the shield stepping forward" | "advancing, step by step, under its cover" | "creeping", "under cover of"; ὑπασπίδια adverb from ὑπό + ἀσπίς, προποδίζω "step forward" |
| κοῦφα ποσὶ προβιβάς (13.158) | "lightly with his feet striding forward" | "striding forward lightly on his feet" | "nimbly" (kept for ῥίμφα), "swiftly"; κοῦφα "lightly" |
| ταυρείη (ἀσπίδα ταυρείην, 13.161, 13.163) | "of bull’s hide" · "bull’s-hide shield" | "of bull’s hide" | "ox-hide" (the table's ῥινός / βόειος "ox"), "bullock"; ταῦρος "bull" |
| ἐν καυλῷ (ἐάγη δολιχὸν δόρυ, 13.162) | "in the shaft" | "in the shaft" | "at the socket", "in the stem"; καυλός "stem" of a spear, the exact spot unclear |
| ξυνέαξε (ἔγχεος ὃ ξυνέαξε, 13.166) | "which was broken up" | "that had been shattered" (+ note: the subject is not stated) | "which he broke" (commits to Meriones), "which broke it" (commits to the shield), "which broke up" (reads the transitive aorist as intransitive); the English passive keeps the Greek's open subject |
| Δηΐφοβος … Πριαμίδης (13.156–157) | "Priam’s-son" | "son of Priam" | follows the table's Πριαμίδης (Hector Priam’s-son, 13.78) |
| ὣς εἰπὼν ὄτρυνε μένος καὶ θυμὸν ἑκάστου (13.155) | "So having spoken, he urged on the might and the heart of each man." | "So he spoke, and urged on the might and the heart of each man." | reused verbatim from iliad-031 (no departure) |
| τοὺς ὅ γ’ ἐποτρύνων ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα (13.94, whole line) | "Them he, urging on, winged words he spoke:" | "Urging them on, he spoke winged words to them:" | the table's ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα unchanged; ἐποτρύνων "urging on" as in odyssey-073 (208); "addressed" and "exhorting" reserved |
| αἰδὼς Ἀργεῖοι, κοῦροι νέοι (13.95) | "Shame, Argives, youths, young ones" | "Shame, Argives, you young men!" | "Fie", "For shame"; follows αἰδὼς Ἀργεῖοι (5.787) |
| ἔγχεσιν ἀμφιγύοισιν (13.147) | "double-pointed spears" | "double-pointed spears" | reused from odyssey-081 and odyssey-119 (no departure); "two-edged", "sharp at both ends" |
